entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Man, it's crazy how many people[n]want us to change the heart of[n]the Okumura Foods CEO.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That aside, does everyone[n]remember the plan for today?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
